input: Get a professional headshot taken for LinkedIn

gold.taskTitle: Get a Professional LinkedIn Headshot Taken
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to get a professional headshot photograph taken specifically for use on their LinkedIn profile.

questions.title: Do you want to hire a photographer or use another method?
questions.description: Understand whether the user wants a professional studio photographer, a freelance photographer, a friend with a camera, or an AI-generated headshot service.

questions.title: What is your budget for this headshot?
questions.description: Determine how much the user is willing to spend, as this affects which photographers or services are realistic options.

questions.title: When do you need the final photo ready by?
questions.description: Establish a deadline so the plan can account for booking lead times and photo editing turnaround.

questions.title: What city or area are you located in?
questions.description: Identify the user's location to find relevant local photographers or studios.

questions.title: What industry or role should the photo convey?
questions.description: Understand the professional context so the style, backdrop, and attire guidance matches the user's field.

questions.title: Do you have a preferred style, backdrop, or setting in mind?
questions.description: Find out if the user has a vision for indoor vs. outdoor, plain background vs. environmental, formal vs. business casual.

questions.title: Do you already have outfits selected for the shoot?
questions.description: Determine if wardrobe planning needs to be part of the task or if the user is already prepared on that front.
